title: Brief check accepts an observer path with trailing punctuation
body:
Outcome: krn brief check finds the Proof observer when its path token ends in punctuation (e.g. `test/x.test.ts`: or a trailing comma), or names the token it rejected. In t-m8j0mt7 the Proof line 'Observer `test/cli/verify-strict-evidence.test.ts`:' made src/brief/sections.ts:92-99 pick the next path (test/cli/verify.test.ts), and the check printed only 'first step must contain the Proof observer and red' (two lead rounds).
Proof: an observer gives brief check a Proof whose first observer path ends in ':' and asserts PASS with that path in the --observer argv.
